repo.description:
## Summary
The `Settings/Updates` Livewire component does not check `isInstanceAdmin()` in its `mount()` method, unlike all other Settings components.

## Affected Code
`app/Livewire/Settings/Updates.php` - missing `isInstanceAdmin()` check.

Compare with other Settings components that all have this check:
- `Settings/Index.php` (line 61)
- `Settings/Advanced.php` (line 57)
- `Settings/ScheduledJobs.php` (line 49)

## Impact
Non-admin users can access the Updates settings page and potentially modify auto-update settings or trigger update checks.

## Suggested Fix
Add `isInstanceAdmin()` check in `mount()` consistent with other Settings components.

## Affected Version
v4.0.0-beta.468
repo.summary: Settings/Updates Livewire Component Missing isInstanceAdmin() Authorization Check
